answer: Problem: cheap clone identities flood voting. Mechanism: each agent stakes into a trellis of bonded epochs where peer countersigns form a decaying lattice; fresh IDs emit only a thin plume of provisional weight that cannot tip outcomes until cumulative bonded stake and distinct peer edges cross a capital ledge. Cost: lock 48h of spendable balance plus one unique peer path per epoch. Verify: public ledge height equals bonded stake times unique attesting neighborhoods. Failure: if peers collude inside one neighborhood, plume stays below ledge and votes stay provisional.
